reviewed_mechanics.sar: Second-close direction with equality bearish; first output undefined; advance, reversal, strict extreme acceleration update, then preceding one/two opposite-extreme clamp. Independent scalar recurrence agrees exactly on synthetic fixtures.
reviewed_mechanics.psar_shared_profile: Shared Ichimoku profile intentionally reused for long-only full-cash PSAR ATR14 bracket, source close anchors and next-open source exits. Replacements retain original qualifying-long flag independently of randomized/lag entry flags. Full ambiguous histories are retained or fail closed at caps.
reviewed_mechanics.cmf: 21-bar signed flow sum divided by volume sum. Undefined zero-range/zero-volume windows suppress sign triggers. Stop is 95 percent of actual accepted entry open. ROI is fixed 0.1 percent each-side fee formula, rounded to 8 decimals and strictly greater than 1 percent; economic cost stress is separately charged.
reviewed_mechanics.priority: Pending source/ROI next-open exits precede that minute range; source reason wins shared boundary. Resting stop precedes same-minute ROI close observation. Final close ROI without subsequent open creates no artificial fill.
reviewed_mechanics.accounting: Signal-close intended full-cash quantity plus cost reserve; all-or-reject next-open entry with no resize; cash and proportional BTC counterfactual settlement/valuation retained. Held/rejected/unexecuted flags reconcile. Censored positions remain holdings marked by liquidation valuation estimand; no executed terminal exit manufactured.
reviewed_mechanics.diagnostics_controls: Reuses frozen PSR11 four-week clustered bootstrap, candidate-adjusted intervals, actual entry-week counts, causal BTC regime/volatility features, randomized-entry causal reruns with endogenous durations, eligible-only seven-bar lag, cost/gap stress and full-history conservative gates.
